0022600220.text: The Bulls (1-8, 14th in the East) host the Spurs (9-2, 2nd in the West) as Chicago looks to end a seven-game losing streak, while San Antonio arrives on a nine-game winning streak and a perfect 5-0 road record. Chicago is without Tobe Awaka (out, back), while Caleb Wilson, Norman Powell and Zach Collins are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions; San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (out, calf strain), and Devin Vassell is day-to-day with a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Bulls lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 129-114 in San Antonio on March 30.
